title: Adjust for the paint layer - grow / shrink / edge band over RGBA (the outline tool)
description:
Adjust (MPI-382) is mask-only. Point the SAME primitive at the RGBA paint layer, which also gives the app its outline tool.

WHY THIS AND NOT AN OUTLINE MODE ON SHAPES (user, 2026-08-04): an outline option on the MPI-368 gizmo would be a second, worse implementation of something Adjust already does properly - and Adjust outlines ANY paint, not just a shape. MPI-368 therefore ships filled-only.

THE REUSE IS REAL AND SMALL. MaskManager._morph(src, r) is blur-then-threshold over a canvas ALPHA channel and does not care that its source is binary; it returns a shared scratch buffer holding the morphed alpha as a white shape. Only the FILL differs per direction:
- Shrink: destination-in the morphed alpha against the paint layer - every original colour survives, the edge eats inward.
- Grow: fill the grown region in the current paint colour, then draw the ORIGINAL layer back on top so existing pixels keep their own colour (the new ring is the only flat part).
- Edge band: dilate(outward) minus erode(inward), filled in the current colour. That IS "outline my scribble in colour X" - the headline of this card.

SHAPE OF THE WORK: a paint destination for the Adjust primitive plus its panel in the Paint rail group. Reuse MPI-382 whole - the Grow/Edge radio that GATES the slider row, the mirrored Inward track, live preview then explicit Apply, and the two traps it paid for: every frame recomputes from a PRISTINE copy taken on begin (feeding output back in eats detail, the MPI-351 double-scale bug), and Apply is a layer-wide ONE SHOT so it takes paint._recordUndo() after the no-op guard, never UndoStack.pendingLayer(), which is a gesture facility.

PREVIEW: an un-applied adjustment is DISCARDED on leaving the tool - hang it on el.discardPreview(), the ONE seam, never the mountOptions() call site (docs/masking-tools.md). The mask preview lives in adjustCanvas drawn INSTEAD of maskCanvas; the paint preview needs the same treatment against the paint layer or the user judges the old scribble and the proposed one at once.

REGISTRATION IS SILENT WHEN MISSED: the new mode joins _PAINT_TOOLS (NOT _MASK_TOOLS - a miss there drives the mask layer while looking correct) and TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY, and every new el.* name goes in MpiCanvas._methods. tests/mask-tool-registry.test.cjs guards it.

READ FIRST: docs/masking-tools.md § Adjust (the primitive, the measured radius table, the two traps), docs/painting.md (the layer model and why opacity is DISPLAY opacity), docs/masking-undo.md (layer-wide one-shot recording).

UMBRELLA: added to MPI-424 as a follow-up after MPI-373. Not blocked by MPI-368 - they share no code, and Shapes shipping filled-only is what makes this card the outline story.
acceptance: The Adjust primitive drives the RGBA paint layer as well as the mask layers, off ONE _morph implementation - a second copy means the reuse regressed
Grow fills the new ring in the current paint colour and leaves existing painted pixels their own colour
Shrink eats the edge inward and changes no surviving pixel colour
Edge band produces an OUTLINE of the painted region in the current colour - the user-facing headline of the card
Live preview then explicit Apply; every preview frame derives from the pristine copy taken on begin, never from the previous frame
An un-applied adjustment is discarded by el.discardPreview() on leaving the tool, and records no undo entry
Apply records exactly ONE UndoStack entry (layer-wide one shot, _recordUndo after the no-op guard) and Ctrl+Z restores the layer
The mode is in _PAINT_TOOLS and TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY, and mask Adjust is unchanged - both guarded by tests/mask-tool-registry.test.cjs
